Question 9

At each point P on a particular curve, the derivative y′(x) is proportional to the shortest distance from P to the x-axis. The derivative at the point (−3,6) equals 12. What differential equation describes this curve?

a
y′(x)=2|y|
b
y′(x)=|y|8
c
y′(x)=|y|4
d
y′(x)=|x|2
e
y′(x)=4|x|
